description: You ordered 6 items for a home office setup during holiday sales. Multiple packages have issues: damaged goods, missing deliveries, stuck shipments. Each seller has different refund deadlines. Your new remote job starts in 7 days and you need working equipment. Create a spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/package_disputes.xlsx to track all disputes, calculate deadline urgency, flag priorities, and total potential refund amounts. Package details: (1) Monitor 27" - Arrived cracked - Ordered Nov 24 - FedEx FDX7723891 - $289 - 30-day return. (2) Desk Chair - Marked delivered Dec 1, never received - UPS TRK9384756 - $245 - 14-day claim. (3) Desk Lamp - Stuck in transit since Nov 28 - USPS 9400123456 - $67 - 30-day guarantee. (4) Webcam - Box empty when opened Dec 3 - Amazon TBA9876543 - $124 - 30-day return. (5) Cable Organizer - Arrived fine (no issue). (6) Office Supplies - Wrong items shipped - FedEx FDX8829341 - $43 - 60-day return. Today is December 5, 2024. Job starts December 12, 2024. Include columns for: item name, tracking number, carrier, order date, issue type, policy days, claim deadline, days until deadline (formula), refund amount, priority flag (URGENT if <7 days AND >$100), and evidence checklist (photo taken, tracking screenshot, seller contacted). Calculate total potential refund from items with issues. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
